CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #10
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

2. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Crafts.
   D. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Crafts with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics and Mosaic: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics and Mosaic.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Athletics and Mosaic.
   C. Practise Athletics and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Athletics and Mosaic.

5. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

6. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the costume

7. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

8. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   C. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.

9. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal.

10. Best practice when working on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Careers in Creative Arts and Sports.

11. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games.

12. Best practice when working on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts : (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Indigenous Kenyan Crafts and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Swimming and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

MARKING SCHEME
====

1. D — Red, blue, and yellow

2. D — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Crafts with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. A — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. C — Practise Athletics and Mosaic with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. B — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

6. C — The speed of the music

7. A — Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts and Sports 3.1 Anal with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Practise Careers in Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. A — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games Board games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. A — Practise Swimming 10 2.12.2 Kenyan Indigenous Games 10 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts  with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

16. (4 marks)
